description: With a real seat assignment, select Profile from the header, verify the displayed identity, save a personal field and reload the URL to verify persistence. Confirm the same seat still receives a 404 on user administration.
Verify the seat profile omits API Keys and a direct tab link selects Profile. Verify the same link opens API Keys for an eligible ordinary MSP user.
Run the existing DB-backed seat credential check and confirm general key issuance is refused and creates no key.
